messages:
maria: quick thread  dropped a new compact layout for the Usage & Billing panel. proto: https://redwood.design/p/compact-axis :eyes:
aj: nice. single question: when you switch scope (org <-> project) do we keep the time range and denom? I couldn't tell.
sam: noticed that switching resets denom to USD  this breaks token-first workflows. can we persist denom at user level or at least session?
kyle: a11y: legend swatches fall under 4:1 in dark theme. bump to token-neutral-300. scope toggle needs an aria-label; screen readers announce just "button" now.
olivia: invoice CTA: prefer context-aware copy e.g. "Download project invoice" or "Download org invoice" depending on scope. non-admins should see a disabled CTA with tooltip "Requires billing access".
billing-bot: FYI invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and 403 for users without billing perms. UI should map these to "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted" with next steps. avoid raw codes.
aj: layout choice: compact axis keeps token breakdown above the chart; alternate is a left sticky rail. desktop favours left rail for scanning; compact axis is denser for mobile. propose left-rail on >=1024px, stacked card on smaller.
sam: agree. also add a tiny denom toggle inline: tokens <-> USD. do transform client-side using cached per-range rates to avoid backend round trips. persist toggle state per-user.
kyle: keyboard focus order: denom toggle should be tabbable and announce units. example aria: <button aria-label="Toggle unit: tokens or USD">tokens</button>.
maria: action items: 1) persist denom per-user/session (sam) 2) left-rail >=1024px, stacked card <1024px (aj + design) 3) client-side denom toggle with cached rates + persisted state (maria + sam) 4) invoice CTA contextual + friendly error mapping (olivia + billing-bot) 5) a11y contrast + aria labels (kyle). I'll update figma and ship a tiny desktop A/B by EOD.
aj: when A/B is live we'll run a quick hall-test (3 folks) and collect notes. :thumbsup:
